title: Mechanisms underlying divergent responses of genetically distinct macrophages to IL-4.
authors: Hoeksema, Marten A; Shen, Zeyang; Holtman, Inge R; Zheng, An; Spann, Nathan J; Cobo, Isidoro; Gymrek, Melissa; Glass, Christopher K
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习分析巨噬细胞表观遗传数据，研究非编码遗传变异对IL-4增强子激活及转录因子组合的影响，虽涉及TF-DNA结合位点预测，但对象为巨噬细胞而非典型TF-DNA互作体系，方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: Mechanisms by which noncoding genetic variation influences gene expression remain only partially understood but are considered to be major determinants of phenotypic diversity and disease risk. Here, we evaluated effects of >50 million single-nucleotide polymorphisms and short insertions/deletions provided by five inbred strains of mice on the responses of macrophages to interleukin-4 (IL-4), a cytokine that plays pleiotropic roles in immunity and tissue homeostasis. Of >600 genes induced >2-fold by IL-4 across the five strains, only 26 genes reached this threshold in all strains. By applying deep learning and motif mutation analyses to epigenetic data for macrophages from each strain, we identified the dominant combinations of lineage-determining and signal-dependent transcription factors driving IL-4 enhancer activation. These studies further revealed mechanisms by which noncoding genetic variation influences absolute levels of enhancer activity and their dynamic responses to IL-4, thereby contributing to strain-differential patterns of gene expression and phenotypic diversity.
abstract_zh: 非编码遗传变异影响基因表达的机制目前仅被部分理解，但被认为是表型多样性和疾病风险的主要决定因素。在此，我们评估了来自五个近交系小鼠品系的超过5000万个单核苷酸多态性和短插入/缺失对巨噬细胞对白细胞介素-4（IL-4）反应的影响，IL-4是一种在免疫和组织稳态中发挥多效性作用的细胞因子。在五个品系中，IL-4诱导超过2倍表达的600多个基因中，仅有26个基因在所有品系中达到此阈值。通过将深度学习和基序突变分析应用于每个品系巨噬细胞的表观遗传数据，我们识别了驱动IL-4增强子激活的谱系决定性和信号依赖性转录因子的主导组合。这些研究进一步揭示了非编码遗传变异影响增强子活性绝对水平及其对IL-4动态反应的机制，从而促成品系差异性的基因表达模式和表型多样性。
